information.description:
When Arasaka Security has to breach bunkers or other heavily fortified hovels, they call on the specialists of the specialists. These bulky grunts carry the firepower, cybernetics, and explosives to breach any location’s front door without fear. That they tend to prefer the competition’s armaments is only permitted because of their other talents.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Arasaka).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

Shotguns aren't exactly known for finesse: While powerful, they often suffer from clunkiness and imprecision. That is, except for the L-69 Zhuo by Kang Tao. Just like the other weapons manufactured by the Chinese corp, the L-69 Zhuo comes packed with top-of-the-line electronics. The ultra-sensitive radar scans the area for you, identifying targets all on its own. And one of the eight bullets in the below-barrel magazine is always ready and waiting to tear someone to shreds.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Shotgun

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 32 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Improved Smart Ammunition, which is purchased in increments of 16 instead of 10 (Cost is unchanged), and can only be fired by this weapon. Firing this weapon expends 8 rounds at once. It will not fire while there are less than 8 rounds in the magazine. Each time this weapon makes an Attack, the user must choose if the fired ammunition functions as a Slug or Shell.

Range: Shotgun
Pre-installed: Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Cost: 250eb (Expensive)

Using nano-kevlar and composite ceramics enables making highly mobile mid-level armor.

Medium Armorjack with an Armor Penalty of -1 to MOVE, and -2 to REF and DEX.

Covers: Head
SP: 12
Armor Penalty: -2 REF, -2 DEX, -1 MOVE

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo's penalty is -2 REF, -2 DEX, -1 MOVE. The sheet applies one penalty to all three stats, so it uses -2; add the difference back by hand for the lighter stat(s).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Catalog).

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

During the Unification War, many “adaptive” combat armor designs were field tested. These trade all-around improvement for extreme specialization in reactivity, speed, or flexibility.

Body/Head Armor Enhancement. When installed, choose to reduce the penalty applied to a single STAT from the armor’s Armor Penalty (if any) by 2 (Minimum 0) (e.g., Reduce Flak Armor’s REF penalty by 2, but no reduction to DEX/MOVE penalties [-2 to REF, -4 to DEX and MOVE]). Cannot be Tech Upgraded to further reduce Armor Penalties.

Type: Armor Enhancement (Body/Head)
Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.
  • The sheet uses one penalty for all three stats, so apply this by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Enhancements & Kits).

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

“Some use newtech armor kits to move faster or shoot rifles easier. I use ‘em to bolt on so many layers I can headbutt a fuckin’ rocket and not get scratched.” — Anonymous BARGHEST member

Armor Attachment. May only be installed into a piece of Body/Head Armor with an innate Armor Penalty. Installing this requires a DV17 Basic Tech Skill Check, and cannot be removed once installed. The armor’s SP is increased by 3, but its Armor Penalty (if any) is increased by 1 (e.g., Heavy Armorjack [SP13, -2 to REF/DEX/MOVE] becomes SP16 with -3 to REF/DEX/MOVE). On a second installation, the armor’s SP is again increased by 3 (+6 SP Total), and its Armor Penalty to REF is again increased by 1, but its Armor Penalty to DEX and MOVE is instead increased by 2 (e.g., Heavy Armorjack [SP13, -2 to REF/DEX/MOVE] with 2 Superheavy Plates becomes SP19 with -4 to REF and -5 to DEX/MOVE). Further installations do nothing.

Type: Armor Attachment (Body/Head Armor with an Armor Penalty)
Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.
  • +3 SP (automated) and +1 to the Armor Penalty.
  • Raise the armor's penalty by hand.

Smart Glasses with pre-installed Image Enhance, which does not consume any Option Slots and cannot be removed. Unlike regular Smart Glasses, these cannot be modified to use an alternate frame or style, and obscure the user’s eyes from external view.
